title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode17 How Not to Fail

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you... I mean... I...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had no idea you could ride it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Quick, Emu! We can't let her get away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That robot's too fast!
What was Rui thinking making it so speedy?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gah... We were close but she keeps getting away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're not here? ...Good. I must have shaken them off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene! Where are you! Come out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh no, they still haven't given up?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I have to get out of here!
I'm almost at the main gate. Just a little farther...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sh-She jumped down from the top of the gate?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, are you okay, Nene? I didn't hurt you, did I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I get it... You don't want to talk to me after all the mean things I said to you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You don't have to say anything, but please listen to what I have to say. I'm really sorry about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I lashed out because I was so crushed when the show didn't go as planned. But I should've realized that you felt far worse than I did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was being selfish.
I didn't consider your feelings, nor anyone else's.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It took me a while, but I finally remembered what it was that I really wanted—to make shows that make people smile.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A happy audience makes us, the performers, happy too. That's what makes it worth pouring everything we have into creating the best theatrical productions we can.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And for that...I would really like you to be part of our troupe, Nene. If you want to?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I've loved theater since I was little...
When I was in junior high school, I joined a large troupe as a junior member.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I practiced and practiced, and eventually I was given the
leading role in a production...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone put so much effort into that show, but it was all for nothing, because I forgot my lines.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Since then, whenever I feel people's eyes on me, I start shaking and get tongue-tied...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then Rui made Robo-Nene for me... Even when I was just remotely controlling the robot...I really enjoyed taking part in the play!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What you said, Tsukasa... It's true. I know I can't perform to the best of my ability if I'm not even able to...get on stage and face the audience. But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's a sure way to never make a mistake.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Don't ever try anything new, and you'll never make a mistake.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those are the words of a certain star I look up to.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't avoid making mistakes when you challenge yourself, but with each one of them, you get closer to the perfect performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm ashamed for taking out my frustration on you when all you did was attempt something new.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, I admit that I was wrong. But this, I really mean.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's keep doing shows together!
Let's try together to stage the most amazing shows ever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Yes! I... I want this too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for...having me in your troupe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yaaay!
I'm so happy you're staying with us, Nene! And Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I'm happy too. Thank you.
